notable_events: Quiet shift, routine PM rounds on lines 1-6, no breakdowns reported.

Gearbox03 checked, no new leakage beyond known drip, oil level acceptable. Uneventful otherwise.

Calm night, all lines running, only open item remains Gearbox03 awaiting seal part.

No open work orders outstanding at plant close; routine PM rounds only.
Pump01 coupling elastomer insert replaced after debris found on guard (WO-2026-100221).
Quiet night, no new issues logged.

Conv02 photo-eye sensor replaced ending intermittent stoppages (WO-2026-100222); Motor07 rewound unit reinstalled and load-tested (WO-2026-100223); Compressor01 routine intake filter service (WO-2026-100224); Gearbox03 next-day dry-check confirmed no leaks (follow-up on WO-2026-100213).
End of week wrap-up, all Plant A work orders closed, handover notes passed to weekend on-call technician.
Press01 die cushion nitrogen seal replaced after repeated pressure top-ups (WO-2026-100207).
Uneventful night, all lines running.

No new issues.

Chiller02 braze repair scheduled for next available window pending parts staging, no other issues.

No change overnight.

Conv05 running on backup short-route conveyor, throughput reduced but stable; awaiting gearmotor delivery.

Data logger running on Press01 drive overnight; Conv05 backup route holding; handover notes passed to weekend crew.
